subject: distsamp -  Different fitted values for different transect lengths

messages.author: d3236a9be3be2e20
messages.subject: distsamp -  Different fitted values for different transect lengths
parts:
Hi everyone,
I'm trying to estimate densities of Thrushes in South America during the winter. 
I conducted transects during three years during December, January and February in three study sites and surveyed two habitats in each site, coffee and forest.
My best Models was ~Site~Habitat+Year (keyfun="halfnorm"). However my model did not pass the fit statistics described in the Unmarked documentation.

After looking at the observed vs. predicted values I found that the model gives me different predicted values when the transect length is different. For example I get 
predicted values for:

Site 1 year 1 Habitat forest
Site 1 year 1 Habitat coffee
Site 2 year 1 Habitat forest
Site 2 year 1 Habitat coffee
Site 3 year 1 Habitat forest
Site 3 year 1 Habitat coffee     and so in for years 2 and 3.

Let's say most of my transects in Site 1 Year 1 Habitat forest are 500, but there is one that is 300 m so the model gives me a different predicted values for that transect.
I read related posts in this group but could't find a solution. I'll appreciate if someone can help me out.

Many thanks
Ana

Just in case my mistake is here, here is the code I used to create the ltUMF:

yDat <- formatDistData(fulldata, distCol="Distance",

                       transectNameCol="Tran_ID", dist.breaks=c(0, 6, 12, 18, 24,30,38))

 

SWTH<- fulldata[,c("Tran_ID", "Site","Habitat","length","Year")]

Transect<-SWTH[!duplicated(SWTH$Tran_ID),]

Transect

SWTH_Final<-data.frame(yDat,Transect)

 

 

ltUMF <- with(SWTH_Final, {

  unmarkedFrameDS(y = cbind(X.0.6., X.6.12., X.12.18., X.18.24.,X.24.30.,X.30.38.),

                  siteCovs = data.frame(Site, Habitat,Year),

                  dist.breaks = c(0, 6, 12, 18, 24,30,38),

                  tlength = SWTH_Final $length, survey = "line", unitsIn = "m")

})
